pipeline.modality: Autologous engineered T cell therapy (Chimeric Engulfment Receptor / CER T cell)
pipeline.target: TIM-4 / phosphatidylserine 'eat-me' signal on tumor cells

indications.indication: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML), myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), and myelofibrosis (MF) — relapsed/refractory hematologic malignancies
indications.trial_name: Phase 1 study of CER-1236 in AML/MDS/MF
indications.trial_design: Open-label dose-escalation Phase 1 study with lymphodepletion (cyclophosphamide/fludarabine/mesna) followed by CER-1236 infusion in adults with R/R AML, MDS, or MF
key_milestones: FDA Orphan Drug Designation for AML (June 2025)

excluded_preclinical: CER-1236 in solid tumors — preclinical/IND-enabling per company website
Additional CER T-cell platform candidates — preclinical
